fine_trace.note: The attribute message bytes in the HDF5 file control the decoded attribute-name length used to advance the message cursor.
The same input-controlled attribute header supplies the datatype-message length passed to the datatype decoder.

The decoder validates the stored name length using strlen on data copied from the message but does not first prove that the subsequent name, datatype, dataspace, and data fields all fit inside the p_size-byte attribute message buffer.

fine_trace.code: if (NULL == (attr->shared->dt = (H5T_t *)(H5O_MSG_DTYPE->decode)(f, open_oh, ((flags & H5O_ATTR_FLAG_TYPE_SHARED) ? H5O_MSG_FLAG_SHARED : 0), ioflags, attr->shared->dt_size, p)))
fine_trace.note: After advancing p by the input-controlled name length without an end-of-message check, the datatype decoder reads from the remaining attribute-message buffer according to the input-controlled datatype size, reaching a heap-buffer-overflow read when the serialized datatype is truncated or malformed.
